representativeSnapshot.kind: fresh local Supabase schema plus production-schema review before promotion

rowCountQueries: Count ticket_types, ticket_sales, financial_transactions, events_v2, and existing ticketing foundation tables
Count ticket_types and financial_transactions rows that would violate the new NOT VALID checks
Confirm no active migration already creates the ticketing foundation tables
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: New foundation tables are empty on a fresh database; persistent rows are preserved and constraint violations remain visible for reviewed forward validation

execution.resumeStrategy: All tables, columns, indexes, policies, functions, and extensions are additive or replace guarded; existing-table checks and the allocation FK are created NOT VALID for forward validation
execution.idempotency: CREATE IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, named policies/functions, and deterministic indexes permit safe reruns through reviewed forward migrations

quarantine.strategy: Do not infer or delete existing ticketing identities; record unresolved scope or constraint violations for a reviewed forward validation

constraints: ticket_types visibility check is created NOT VALID and requires a later reviewed VALIDATE CONSTRAINT
tickets allocation foreign key is created NOT VALID and requires a later reviewed VALIDATE CONSTRAINT
financial_transactions ticketing category check is replaced with a NOT VALID check and requires a later reviewed VALIDATE CONSTRAINT
indexes: ticket inventory, tickets, credentials, transfers, check-ins, allocations, revenue, grants, webhook, and analytics indexes
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: After fresh application and a production-schema review, validate each NOT VALID constraint, run security/performance advisors, and capture Org A/Org B, owner, delegated manager, recipient, service-role, and unrelated-user evidence

recovery.rollback: Disable ticketing-dependent feature flags and use a reviewed forward migration; do not delete ticketing records or reset the database
recovery.forwardFix: Resolve quarantined rows or constraint violations with additive corrections, validate the named constraints, and rerun the ADM-B01 fresh/upgrade/RLS matrix

queries: Verify all ticketing foundation tables, columns, indexes, functions, policies, and RLS flags exist
Verify NOT VALID constraint state and quarantined violations
Reconcile ticket inventory, allocations, reservations, tickets, financial transactions, and idempotency keys
Run Supabase security and performance advisors for the affected tables and functions
